notes:
New Features:

- Adds safer HLS self-healing: media-sequence resets can trigger an immediate fresh re-resolve, while a recent zero-cache sample can recover a stream after an unexpected EOF.
- Active recovery now performs a controlled stop before opening the freshly resolved URL so the old stalled player does not overlap the replacement stream.
- Removes Guljaj completely from Adult TV Test, including the Site entry, Settings tab, login/status workflow, stream resolver and saved Guljaj credentials/resolution state.

Improvements:

- Adult IPTV now enables the PVR IPTV Simple remote M3U/EPG cache so the last valid list remains available when m3u4u is temporarily unavailable during Kodi startup.
- Release Notes now use one continuous scrollable text area and preserve the release wording, bullet order and spacing instead of redistributing the text into fixed-height sections.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes v1.113 recovery missing .com failures when the diagnostic manifest kept advancing even though the Kodi playback session was about to end.
- Fixes recovery opening a replacement resolver on top of an already stalled player, which could resolve a fresh URL without completing the playback handoff.
